entries.mechanism: The Axiom/PolicyEngine leg applies Oregon's 2026 indexed brackets and taxable-income adjustments, while the pinned TAXSIM leg applies 2024 law. The exact residual is the indexation and law-vintage difference.

The Axiom leg evaluates the fixtures' completed Oregon taxable income, whose baked-in indexed deduction/bracket vintage sits one indexation step behind PolicyEngine's 2026 projection — a constant $3.50 (single) / $6.00 (married) residual across the whole income grid. Oregon DOR's official 2026 indexed amounts (and the HB 3753 deduction change) are not yet reflected by either side. Actionable upstream: regenerate the rulespec-us companion fixtures via the encoder once official 2026 amounts publish; not fixable in this repo.
